description: Regression thresholds for the Zenith performance harness. A CI run fails if any metric in any scenario regresses by more than `defaultThreshold`. Per-scenario and per-metric overrides are supported. The `soroban-vault` block documents per-entry-point resource budgets (CPU instructions, memory bytes, ledger entry reads/writes) with explicit headroom against current Soroban limits; the benchmark harness in scripts/ compares measured worst-case numbers against these budgets and fails CI when an entry point exceeds its budget by more than `regressionThreshold`.

commitCount.note: Commit count on spot ticks should be very stable

totalLongTaskMs.note: Any long task on a spot tick is a regression regardless of baseline

p95RenderMs.note: Slightly more lenient — MTM rows vary more between runs
Tab switch mounts/unmounts heavy panels; more variance expected

totalRenderMs.note: Vault detail page with epoch timeline and sidebar
Epoch phase change re-render must stay tight

totalLongTaskMs.note: Zero long tasks allowed during epoch transition

soroban-vault.description: Per-entry-point resource budgets for the vault contract suite. Numbers are worst-case (vault at capacity, full withdrawal queue, epoch with many expired positions) and are compared against the current Soroban network limits. `regressionThreshold` is the fraction by which a measured value may exceed its budget before CI fails.

networkLimits.note: Current Soroban per-transaction limits; update when the network raises them.

epochClose.note: Worst case: at-capacity depositor set with many expired positions; batched via cursor so a single invocation stays within limits.
